reference: Approved wave art and the supplied Vietnamese classroom video.

files.wave-cycle.png: Production animation sprite atlas, TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Image 1 is the approved wave style, image 2 is the original Vietnamese cartoon boat game. Create FOUR DISTINCT sequential animation drawings of the SAME turquoise foamy river wave, in a perfectly regular 2 COLUMN by 2 ROW grid (4 equal square cells). TOP LEFT: rising rounded swell, low wave starting to curl. TOP RIGHT: tallest fully curled crest with thick creamy WHITE FOAM and open circular hollow, splashing droplets, dramatic but friendly. BOTTOM LEFT: the crest falls and breaks into two smaller rolling curls with lots of spray. BOTTOM RIGHT: the wave has collapsed into a low wide foam wash, splash and ripples. This must read as rising -> cresting -> breaking -> receding, NOT four identical waves. All frames face RIGHT, have exactly the SAME baseline near 90% cell height and same horizontal footprint; keep ALL art and droplets INSIDE their own cell with narrow transparent gutters; baseline consistent for smooth overlay animation. Match reference's soft clean 2D cel shading, dark blue-gray outlines, pale cyan bodies, warm white foam, playful Vietnamese children's storybook animation. Full silhouettes, real alpha around every drawing. No background, no labels, no grid marks, no boats, no people, no text, no cast shadow, no glow. Clearly separated 2x2 equal cells, square overall sheet.
files.jumping-fish.png: Create a transparent 2x2 sprite sheet of cute jumping freshwater fish for the supplied Vietnamese children's boat game. The image is ONLY a reference for clean cartoon outlines and color treatment, do not include a wave. FOUR equal square cells with narrow transparent gutters, every complete fish stays inside its cell. TOP LEFT: one small happy orange-gold carp, side view facing RIGHT, body curving upward, tail flapping, nose slightly up. TOP RIGHT: the SAME orange carp in the downward turning pose, body curved down, nose slightly down, consistent face and scale. BOTTOM LEFT: a friendly silvery BLUE freshwater fish facing RIGHT, nose slightly up, jumping pose. BOTTOM RIGHT: the SAME blue fish in its downward turning pose. Clean polished 2D storybook cel shading, warm friendly little eyes, detailed fins and a few scales, dark blue-gray ink outlines, pale turquoise and orange-gold colors that fit a Vietnamese river cartoon. Real transparent alpha, full bodies and tails, no water, no splash, no bubbles, no scenery, no labels, no glow, no text. Fish centered in each cell at consistent scale. Square overall atlas with exactly two columns and two rows.
